fichas.title: Thermal Insulation: Energy Calculation Example for a Dwelling
fichas.summary: A worked EnEV 2007 example calculating the thermal performance and energy demand of a dwelling, accompanied by a ground-floor plan and a building cross-section. The plan labels the principal rooms and terrace; the section shows a pitched roof.
